name: pm
description: Jira-style personal project management tool covering ongoing projects and personal commitments, with a calendar, reminders, GitHub-backed data storage, a mobile app, and Tailscale exposure on a personal server. Also serves as the communication board for connected agentic AI systems.
flow: User creates projects, creates tasks/subtasks, updates their status. If an agentic system is attached, backlog tasks are automatically populated and picked up by agents; the end user is notified of blockers needing manual attention.

name: knowledge-app
description: Personal ontology application covering a user's entire knowledge base - professional information, people network, and knowledge - via notes, people management, and project management. Creates a personal ontology layer that AIs can access via MCP servers, with visibility into where your data lives for transparent data management.
longTermUpdates: Fold in pm's project management; add MCP servers for functionality; add data-management features - primary asset / secondary asset graphic view
flow: User creates notes about information, people, or projects. System uses AI to identify, enrich, and connect data, and flags entries for more information. AI builds a knowledge graph of all the knowledge, exposed via MCP.

name: knowledge
flow: Skipped in the walkthrough.

name: TUMTOR
description: AI-powered job-market intelligence tool for the German tech industry - reads layoff patterns, salaries, and in-demand skills, then connects them to a TUM student's ambitions to surface clubs, projects, collaborations, and research opportunities that maximize their university time.
quickUpdates: Better README; add screenshots of the application
flow: Ingest validated job-market datasets. User creates an ambition profile. AI ranks jobs and identifies required skills, ranks university opportunities, and applies MMR ranking for diverse/creative options. Generates an explainable report.

name: ts
description: Community-focused application to boost use of third spaces, grounded in research on social loneliness among Gen Z. Helps users find new third spaces and connect with others who are also going. (Represents the ThirdSpaces project; the separate ThirdSpaces repo is a duplicate and was skipped.)
longTermUpdates: Rename repo to ThirdSpaces and merge with the ThirdSpaces repo; update UI; release via Vercel
flow: User creates an account, finds third spaces via the app, and enrolls. When visiting, other enrolled users are visible via the app so they can find each other and say hi.

name: claudeAgents
description: Repository that runs an agentic AI system, currently limited to software development tasks.
longTermUpdates: Rename repo (name TBD); upload the agentic system with an orchestrator
flow: A cron job triggers an agent run. The agent picks up a task from a connected project management board, checks usage limits, breaks the task into subtasks, and completes them via sub-agents (CLI Claude). If human effort is required, a ticket is opened on the connected PM board.

name: couponBuster
description: Authorized security-testing tool that brute-forces discount/coupon codes on input boxes.
flow: User enters a target URL. System identifies the input box and determines rate limiting/confirmation logic, then brute-forces codes using Burp-style request patterns.

name: caesar-cipher-game
description: A game teaching children (and drunk adults) the basics of encryption using a simple Caesar cipher - used at the NavVis Black Out event.
flow: User clicks begin; a Caesar cipher and cipher wheel are presented. The user spins the wheel until the cipher resolves, then receives a reward.

name: medusa
description: Protects artists and their art from deepfakes by poisoning outputted data so any model training on it produces bad results - even if the poisoning is defended against, it raises attacker cost and reduces deepfake frequency. Multi-modal.
flow: Artists upload their art and receive back a humanly-undetectable poisoned version, which is then uploaded to public channels. AI models that unethically scrape this poisoned data see decreased generation quality - the art is protected via poisoning.

name: tuneyloons
description: Graphic visualization tool for DJs recommending which song to cue next, based on music theory - pulls track data from music-labeling provider APIs to visualize compatible songs.
flow: User enters their setlist / connects their DJ system. AI creates recommendations per song as a knowledge graph of song 'vibe' paths. User receives a visual representation of what could be played next and the expected audience response.

name: test-GHAS-repo
flow: Skipped in the walkthrough.

name: ISA
description: Information Security Agent capable of running an organization's Information Security department - asset management, control management, and risk management.
longTermUpdates: Create agentic harness; add all the skills
flow: Agent is deployed and integrated per the user's setup, identifies primary and secondary assets, identifies which frameworks need to be adhered to, evaluates their requirements and attaches them to secondary assets, evaluates current policies/measures, and produces a risk document per secondary asset.

name: buddies
flow: Skipped in the walkthrough (private/personal).

name: aiGovernance
description: EU AI Act checker - identifies the role, risk, and nature of each AI application within a company, and produces the compliance obligations for the application owner.
quickUpdates: Rename repo to EU AI Act Manager; add README
longTermUpdates: Convert to an agentic system capable of surfacing and identifying shadow IT, performing an assumed check, waiting for validation, and producing obligations
flow: User enters an AI tool use case. AI identifies the role, risk, and nature of the AI, and uses a predisposed matrix of obligations to create a report.

name: GamifiedPhishing
description: Open-source gamified phishing-awareness training platform, aimed at teaching kids to recognize phishing.
longTermUpdates: Make it auto-improving based on real-world phishing trends; deploy on Vercel
flow: User enters the website and identifies phishing emails, then identifies the hints/red flags in them. Training completion is recorded.

name: DP-GroupProject
description: Data-processing group project that reads public data to identify key signals about AI governance and use.
quickUpdates: Rename to a more representative name (TBD); add proper README
flow: Ingest public data, extract AI governance signals, generate report.

name: AI-BF
description: AI jailbreak brute-forcer - runs a predisposed prompt list against a target AI to attempt to jailbreak it.
longTermUpdates: Rename repo (name TBD); add README; create a report; test it
flow: User enters a target URL. AI pulls from sources to create a brute-force prompt list, then prompts the target and either changes direction or probes further based on the response. Produces a report on AI security posture.

name: GHAS-Automation
description: Pre-merge security CI/CD pipeline built on GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) workflows.
longTermUpdates: Rework the process to include an AI code checker
flow: User installs local hooks for secret scanning. Before every push, secret scanning runs; before every merge, Dependabot and code scanning run.

name: ThirdSpaces
flow: Skipped in the walkthrough (duplicate of ts - ts is the canonical repo for this project).

name: CTI_Tool
description: Cyber threat intelligence tool using NLP to identify vulnerabilities in a person's immediate surroundings - IoT and personal devices.
longTermUpdates: Add agentic AI; automate device identification; update filters; switch to a web app; automate intelligence sourcing; adhere to STIX/TAXII and STRIDE threat-intel formats
flow: User enters their IoT devices. AI identifies the IoT type and common vulnerabilities, subscribes to relevant RSS feeds and other threat intelligence sources, filters out relevant critical intelligence, and creates a knowledge graph for the end user of devices and vulnerabilities.

name: software_security
description: Web app security testing tool that checks for CSRF, SQL injection, and other OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
longTermUpdates: Rework the UI; verify components are working
flow: User enters a target URL. Different modules (SQLi, CSRF, etc.) run against it. A vulnerability report is generated.
